title: षट्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 46 · The tirthas of Varuna and Brahmarshi

summary.en: Janamejaya marvels at the account, and Vaishampayana tells how the gods consecrated Varuna as lord of the waters. Balarama bathes in the tirtha and goes on to the hermitage of Badarapachana.
summary.kn: ಜನಮೇಜಯ ವೃತ್ತಾಂತ ಕೇಳಿ ಬೆರಗಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದೇವತೆಗಳು ವರುಣನನ್ನು ಜಲಾಧಿಪತಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಭಿಷೇಕಿಸಿದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಲರಾಮ ತೀರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿ ಬದರಪಾಚನ ಆಶ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय वृत्तान्त सुनकर चकित होते हैं, और वैशम्पायन बताते हैं कि देवताओं ने वरुण को जलों का स्वामी अभिषिक्त किया। बलराम तीर्थ में स्नान कर बदरपाचन आश्रम जाते हैं।
summary.te: జనమేజయుడు వృత్తాంతం విని ఆశ్చర్యపడతాడు; దేవతలు వరుణుని జలాధిపతిగా అభిషేకించిన కథను వైశంపాయనుడు చెబుతాడు. బలరాముడు తీర్థంలో స్నానం చేసి బదరపాచన ఆశ్రమానికి వెళతాడు.
summary.ta: இக்கதையைக் கேட்டு ஜனமேஜயன் வியக்க, தேவர் வருணனை நீர்களின் தலைவனாக முடிசூட்டிய கதையை வைசம்பாயனர் கூறுகிறார். பலராமன் தீர்த்தத்தில் நீராடி பதரபாசன ஆசிரமத்துக்குச் செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഈ വിവരണത്തിൽ ജനമേജയൻ അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുന്നു; ദേവന്മാർ വരുണനെ ജലാധിപനായി അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്ത കഥ വൈശമ്പായനൻ പറയുന്നു. ബലരാമൻ ആ തീർത്ഥത്തിൽ സ്നാനം ചെയ്ത് ബദരപചനത്തിന്റെ ആശ്രമത്തിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.46; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

sections.title: सारस्वतपर्व
sections.titleEn: Sarasvata Parva (Balarama's pilgrimage on the Sarasvati)

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
अत्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मञ्श्रुतवानस्मि तत्त्वतः ।
अभिषेकं कुमारस्य विस्तरेण यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, I have heard truly this most wonderful account of Kumara's consecration, told in full and properly.

verses.text:
यच्छ्रुत्वा पूतमात्मानं विजानामि तपोधन ।
प्रहृष्टानि च रोमाणि प्रसन्नं च मनो मम ॥

meaning.en: Hearing it, ascetic, I feel myself purified; my hair stands on end and my mind is clear.

verses.text:
अभिषेकं कुमारस्य दैत्यानां च वधं तथा ।
श्रुत्वा मे परमा प्रीतिर्भूयः कौतूहलं हि मे ॥

meaning.en: Hearing of Kumara's consecration and the slaying of the Daityas, I am supremely pleased and my curiosity grows.

verses.text:
अपां पतिः कथं ह्यस्मिन्नभिषिक्तः सुरासुरैः ।
तन्मे ब्रूहि महाप्राज्ञ कुशलो ह्यसि सत्तम ॥

meaning.en: How was the lord of waters consecrated at this tirtha by gods and asuras? Tell me that, greatly wise one, for you are skilled, best of men.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
शृणु राजन्निदं चित्रं पूर्वकल्पे यथातथम् ।
आदौ कृतयुगे तस्मिन्वर्तमाने यथाविधि ।
वरुणं देवताः सर्वाः समेत्येदमथाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Hear, king, this wonderful account exactly as it was in an earlier age, at the beginning, when the Krita age was properly under way: all the gods gathered and spoke thus to Varuna.

verses.text:
यथास्मान्सुरराट्शक्रो भयेभ्यः पाति सर्वदा ।
तथा त्वमपि सर्वासां सरितां वै पतिर्भव ॥

meaning.en: As Indra, king of the gods, always protects us from fears, so you too be lord of all the rivers.

verses.text:
वासश्च ते सदा देव सागरे मकरालये ।
समुद्रोऽयं तव वशे भविष्यति नदीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Your home shall always be, god, in the ocean, the abode of makaras; and this ocean, lord of rivers, will be under your sway.

verses.text:
सोमेन सार्धं च तव हानिवृद्धी भविष्यतः ।
एवमस्त्विति तान्देवान्वरुणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Your waning and waxing will go together with the Moon's. Varuna said to the gods: so be it.

verses.text:
समागम्य ततः सर्वे वरुणं सागरालयम् ।
अपां पतिं प्रचक्रुर्हि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: Then all gathered around Varuna, whose home is the sea, and made him lord of waters by the rite seen in the scriptures.

verses.text:
अभिषिच्य ततो देवा वरुणं यादसां पतिम् ।
जग्मुः स्वान्येव स्थानानि पूजयित्वा जलेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Having consecrated Varuna, lord of water creatures, the gods honored the lord of waters and went to their own places.

verses.text:
अभिषिक्तस्ततो देवैर्वरुणोऽपि महायशाः ।
सरितः सागरांश्चैव नदांश्चैव सरांसि च ।
पालयामास विधिना यथा देवाञ्शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Consecrated thus by the gods, the greatly renowned Varuna too protected the rivers, seas, great rivers and lakes by rule, as Indra of a hundred sacrifices protects the gods.

verses.text:
ततस्तत्राप्युपस्पृश्य दत्त्वा च विविधं वसु ।
अग्नितीर्थं महाप्राज्ञः स जगाम प्रलम्बहा ।
नष्टो न दृश्यते यत्र शमीगर्भे हुताशनः ॥

meaning.en: Then Balarama, slayer of Pralamba, greatly wise, touched the water there too, gave wealth of many kinds, and went to Agnitirtha, where Agni, hidden, was not to be seen inside a shami tree.

verses.text:
लोकालोकविनाशे च प्रादुर्भूते तदानघ ।
उपतस्थुर्महात्मानं सर्वलोकपितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Sinless one, when the destruction of the world and the worlds beyond appeared imminent, the gods approached the great-souled Grandfather of all worlds.

verses.text:
अग्निः प्रनष्टो भगवान्कारणं च न विद्महे ।
सर्वलोकक्षयो मा भूत्संपादयतु नोऽनलम् ॥

meaning.en: The blessed Agni is lost and we do not know why. Let there be no ruin of all the worlds; let him give us fire back.

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
किमर्थं भगवानग्निः प्रनष्टो लोकभावनः ।
विज्ञातश्च कथं देवैस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Why was the blessed Agni, the sustainer of the worlds, lost, and how did the gods find him? Tell me that truly.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
भृगोः शापाद्भृशं भीतो जातवेदाः प्रतापवान् ।
शमीगर्भमथासाद्य ननाश भगवांस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Jatavedas, the mighty one, deeply afraid of Bhrigu's curse, went into the heart of a shami tree and so vanished.

verses.text:
प्रनष्टे तु तदा वह्नौ देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः ।
अन्वेषन्त तदा नष्टं ज्वलनं भृशदुःखिताः ॥

meaning.en: When Agni was lost, all the gods with Indra, deeply distressed, searched for the vanished fire.

verses.text:
ततोऽग्नितीर्थमासाद्य शमीगर्भस्थमेव हि ।
ददृशुर्ज्वलनं तत्र वसमानं यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Then, reaching Agnitirtha, they saw fire dwelling in the heart of the shami tree as he had been.

verses.text:
देवाः सर्वे नरव्याघ्र बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः ।
ज्वलनं तं समासाद्य प्रीताभूवन्सवासवाः ।
पुनर्यथागतं जग्मुः सर्वभक्षश्च सोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: All the gods, tiger among men, led by Brihaspati, reached that fire and, with Indra, were pleased; they went back as they came, and he became the eater of all things.

verses.text:
भृगोः शापान्महीपाल यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ।
तत्राप्याप्लुत्य मतिमान्ब्रह्मयोनिं जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: Because of Bhrigu's curse, lord of the earth, as the Brahmin spoke it, the wise one bathed there too and went to Brahmayoni.

verses.text:
ससर्ज भगवान्यत्र सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
तत्राप्लुत्य ततो ब्रह्मा सह देवैः प्रभुः पुरा ।
ससर्ज चान्नानि तथा देवतानां यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Where the blessed Grandfather of all worlds created, there Brahma, the lord, long ago bathed with the gods and created foods for the gods by rule.

verses.text:
तत्र स्नात्वा च दत्त्वा च वसूनि विविधानि च ।
कौबेरं प्रययौ तीर्थं तत्र तप्त्वा महत्तपः ।
धनाधिपत्यं संप्राप्तो राजन्नैलबिलः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Having bathed there and given wealth of many kinds, Balarama went to Kubera's tirtha, where, king, the lord Ailabila, Kubera, having practiced great austerity, gained lordship over wealth.

verses.text:
तत्रस्थमेव तं राजन्धनानि निधयस्तथा ।
उपतस्थुर्नरश्रेष्ठ तत्तीर्थं लाङ्गली ततः ।
गत्वा स्नात्वा च विधिवद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं ददौ ॥

meaning.en: While he stood there, king, treasures and riches waited on him, best of men; the plough-bearer then went to that tirtha, bathed by rule and gave wealth to Brahmins.

verses.text:
ददृशे तत्र तत्स्थानं कौबेरे काननोत्तमे ।
पुरा यत्र तपस्तप्तं विपुलं सुमहात्मना ॥

meaning.en: There he saw that place in Kubera's best of forests where long ago the great-souled one had practiced vast austerity,

verses.text:
यत्र राज्ञा कुबेरेण वरा लब्धाश्च पुष्कलाः ।
धनाधिपत्यं सख्यं च रुद्रेणामिततेजसा ॥

meaning.en: where King Kubera gained abundant boons: lordship of wealth, friendship with the immeasurably brilliant Rudra,

verses.text:
सुरत्वं लोकपालत्वं पुत्रं च नलकूबरम् ।
यत्र लेभे महाबाहो धनाधिपतिरञ्जसा ॥

meaning.en: godhood, the post of guardian of the world, and a son, Nalakubara, which the lord of wealth readily gained there, mighty-armed one.

verses.text:
अभिषिक्तश्च तत्रैव समागम्य मरुद्गणैः ।
वाहनं चास्य तद्दत्तं हंसयुक्तं मनोरमम् ।
विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं नैरृतैश्वर्यमेव च ॥

meaning.en: He was consecrated there as well, meeting the troops of Maruts; and there was given to him a charming vehicle yoked with swans, the divine Pushpaka aerial car, and sovereignty over the night-roamers.

verses.text:
तत्राप्लुत्य बलो राजन्दत्त्वा दायांश्च पुष्कलान् ।
जगाम त्वरितो रामस्तीर्थं श्वेतानुलेपनः ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there, king, and giving abundant gifts, Balarama in white unguents went in haste to a tirtha

verses.text:
निषेवितं सर्वसत्त्वैर्नाम्ना बदरपाचनम् ।
नानर्तुकवनोपेतं सदापुष्पफलं शुभम् ॥

meaning.en: visited by all creatures, named Badarapachana, with forests of all seasons, always with flowers and fruit, and lovely.
